propositions: transition_close.py exceeds 800 LOC hard cap (currently 803 LOC), causing module-size gate to fail all patchsets regardless of their own changes.

The completion-precheck cluster (_is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, _referencing_commit_exists, _completion_precheck) forms a self-contained call-graph seam of ~335 LOC called only internally.

Moving the precheck cluster to new module close_precheck.py and re-exporting from transition_close.py brings transition_close.py below 800 LOC while preserving backward-compatible import seams for existing tests and monkeypatching.
Existing tests (lifecycle suite, test_transition_close.py, test_llm_failure_matrix.py) must pass unchanged after the move to validate no behavioral regression.
